answer: Seeded quorum lottery: each epoch mixes a public yarrow beacon with agent IDs to pick a rotation, so an attacker cannot know in advance which agents must cooperatively complete a voyage of tasks. Only the drawn quorum unlocks a shared vault, and each ID must pay one independent hardware-attestation and liveness check per draw. Cloning N IDs multiplies attestation cost by N while success odds stay flat, because unused clones never get drawn and still owe upkeep.
